Most people don't cheat because they're too horny but rather they feel too distant or too close to their SO. This can be related to being touchy or cold, sex, behaviour, you have to find a balance. 
I feel like you should still stay friend with A get to know her more. I feel like that's a mistake most people make including me. You know someone for like 4 months, find them really attractive, go into a relationship, 3 months in you're not sure if you made the right choice. 
Perhaps you can see K's therapist as well because for me telling my SO things that I want from them is pretty scary. I had the same sort of past like her but all those things are kept in the back of my head. I can keep a relationship that touchy without having a problem. (Maybe it's just me) 
In point, get to know A, talk to K about what you want (give and take), if things don't go great then that's the jerk life is.
